description: Version 3 of egfr-456: status 'amended', and the amendment touches ONLY a source-only element - an Observation.note is added. The value, unit, code, subject and effective time are byte-identical to version 2. This is the case the reviewer signed off on when answering R3: a revision that changes the record without changing anything the map binds. The emitted target triples should therefore differ from version 2's only in prov:wasDerivedFrom, while source_json_digest differs outright, so the store must report a replacement rather than 'unchanged'.

lineage.note: Supersedes version 2 (fixtures/r4/egfr/egfr-corrected). No bound pivot variable changes except versionId; Observation.note is tolerated and never mapped.
